fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited has released the DFCCIL CBT 2 Result 2026 for the Multi Tasking Staff and Executive on 13th Februrary 2026. All the candidates appeared for the Exam on 13th December, can check their performance in the DFCCIL Stage 2 Exam. Candidates who have qualified in this stage of exam will now have been provisionally shortlisted for the next round that is the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). A total of 1124 candidates have qualified the DFCCIL MTS Stage 2 exam. The PET is expected to be held in March 2026 and more details will be shared on the official DFCCIL website.

DFCCIL CBT 2 Result 2026 Out

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited announced the DFCCIL MTS Stage 2 result 2026 on 13th February 2026 at the official website. Candidates who appeared for the 2nd Stage CBT for the post of Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) and Executive (Signal & Telecommunication) can now check their result. Those who have qualified in the CBT will appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). The DFCCIL MTS PET is expected to be held in March 2026. Selected candidates will receive the required information through the official website, SMS or email. The DFCCIL MTS and Executive Result 2026 is released in PDF form and applicants can check their roll number in the PDF.

DFCCIL MTS CBT 2 Result 2026 PDF

The DFCCIL MTS Stage 2 Result has been released under Advt No. 01/DR/2025. Candidates can now download the result PDF from the official website. Candidates who appeared for the 2nd Stage CBT held on 13th December 2025 can check their results. To check the result, candidates need to open the PDF and search their roll number to see if they are shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). The link to check the DFCCIL MTS Score Card will soon be active on the official website.

DFCCIL CBT 2 Result 2026 Merit List

Candidates can check their qualifying status and cut-off marks through the DFCCIL Result PDF, which has been uploaded on its official website on 12th February 2026. The candidates qualifying for the CBT 2 exam are now eligible to appear for the PET Exam. Check all important dates regarding the DFCCIL Result 2026 in the table below.

How to Download DFCCIL Result 2026?

Candidates can download the DFCCIL MTS CBT 2 Result from the official website. The cut off marks are released along with the result PDF. Follow the steps given below to check and download it.

Step 1. Visit the official website of DFCCIL at dfccil.com.
Step 2. Go to the “Latest News” or “Results” section.
Step 3. Click on the DFCCIL CBT 2 Result 2026 link.
Step 4. Open the PDF file.
Step 5. Check the category-wise cut off marks in the notice.
Step 6. Download and save the PDF for future use.

DFCCIL MTS CBT 2 Cut Off 2026

The DFCCIL CBT 2 Cut Off has been released along with the DFCCIL Result 2026. The cut -off marks are different for each category. Candidates who scored equal to or more than the cut- off marks have been shortlisted for the PET round. The cut off is prepared based on vacancies and exam difficulty level. DFCCIL CBT 2 Merit List 2026 PDF Download

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited has prepared the DFCCIL Merit List based on the marks scored by candidates in the 2nd Stage CBT. As per the official notice, DFCCIL has called three times the number of vacancies for the PET round (excluding ExSM and PwBD). If more than one candidate scored the same cut-off marks, all such candidates have been included in the list. The roll numbers are arranged in ascending order and not in merit order. The final selection will be made after PET, document verification and medical exam.

DFCCIL MTS CBT 2 Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the DFCCIL Result 2026 released?

Ans: The DFCCIL CBT 2 Result 2026 has been released on 13th February 2026 on the official website. Candidates who appeared in the Stage 2 CBT can check their result online.

Q2. Where can I check the DFCCIL Result 2026?

Ans: You can check the DFCCIL Result 2026 on the official website of DFCCIL at dfccil.com. The result is available in PDF format in the results section.

Q3. How can I check my DFCCIL MTS Result 2026?

Ans: Go to the official website and click on the result link. Download the PDF file and search your roll number to check if you are selected.

Q4. What is the next step after DFCCIL CBT 2 Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates who pass CBT 2 must appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). The PET is expected in March 2026. Full details will be shared on the website, SMS, or email.

Q5. Is the DFCCIL Merit List 2026 released with the result?

Ans: Yes, the merit list is released along with the result notice. It includes roll numbers of candidates who are shortlisted for the next stage of selection that is Physical Efficiency Test..

Q6. When will the DFCCIL Score Card 2026 be available?

Ans: The score card will be released soon after the DFCCIL result 2026. Candidates will be able to check their marks by logging in with their registration details on the official login portal.

Q7. Is the cut-off the same for all categories?

Ans: No, the cut off marks are different for each category like UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS.
